hikes.name: Saddle Mountain
hikes.blurb: The North Coast's highest viewpoint: rare spring wildflowers on a steep basalt ridge, the ocean and five volcanoes from the top.

hikes.name: Cape Falcon
hikes.blurb: Through spruce forest to a headland of salal tunnels with cliffs dropping straight into the surf.

hikes.name: Neahkahnie Mountain
hikes.blurb: Switchbacks up meadows to a rocky summit 1,600 feet straight above the ocean and Manzanita's beach.

hikes.name: Tillamook Head from Indian Beach
hikes.blurb: Up through Ecola's forest to the headland Lewis and Clark crossed, with a lighthouse on a rock offshore.

hikes.name: Kings Mountain
hikes.blurb: A brutally steep climb in the Tillamook Forest to a summit meadow and a view to the ocean.

hikes.name: Elk Mountain
hikes.blurb: Even steeper than Kings: rocky scrambling to a summit over the Wilson River canyon.

hikes.name: Short Sand Beach
hikes.blurb: Down a creek through big spruces to a sheltered surfing cove between two headlands.

hikes.name: Waikiki Beach
hikes.blurb: From Beards Hollow Trailhead, a 5.7-mile round trip to Waikiki Beach, with about 850 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Astoria Column
hikes.blurb: From U.S. Coast Guard, a 1.9-mile round trip to the Astoria Column viewpoint, with about 550 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: University Falls
hikes.blurb: From Stagecoach Horse Camp Trailhead, a 3.2-mile round trip to University Falls, with about 650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Wilson Falls
hikes.blurb: From Footbridge Trail, a 2.9-mile round trip to Wilson Falls, with about 500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Hug Point Falls
hikes.blurb: From Haystack Rock Public Parking, an 8.9-mile round trip to Hug Point Falls.

hikes.name: Wolf Point
hikes.blurb: From Footbridge Trail, an 8.5-mile round trip to the top of Wolf Point (2,377 ft), with about 2,400 feet of climbing.
